policy.holdout: 24 deterministic diverse HUMAN_ACCEPTED targets; target body + full family + core-neighbors <= 0.16 are excluded from retrieval
policy.knownContext: sex + age from hidden target metadata
policy.geometricTargets: canonical rest-mesh-bbox stature + chest + waist + hip measured from hidden target mesh
policy.stature: single canonical solver stature = exact Anny rest-mesh bounding-box height; legacy measurement stature is diagnostic only
policy.measurementGate: technical broad sanity only; visually accepted nodes may be solver-ineligible for a broken measurement without losing human-audit status
policy.weight: excluded from proof scoring and proof preselection
policy.baseline: neutral same-sex, same-age-context Anny body with canonical stature adjusted only
policy.retrieval: trusted bank only; target family and near recipe neighbors excluded; invalid candidate snapshots excluded
policy.controllerProbe: every permitted local controller is probed in +epsilon and -epsilon at the concrete seed; actual measured derivatives choose direction
policy.comparison: same retrieval shortlist -> rank #1 local fit vs independent local fits from ranks #1-#3 -> best final geometry
policy.decision: GO only if family-holdout retrieval median < neutral median AND Top-3 median <= Single-Seed median AND <= retrieval median

summary.reason: Family-/Nahnachbar-bereinigtes Retrieval schlägt neutral im Median; Top-3 enthält den Single-Seed-Pfad und verschlechtert dessen Median nicht.
